candidates.description: This feature vector represents grammatical contractions, articles, and prepositions predominantly found in Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents numerical values corresponding to quantities, measurements, or counts.
This feature vector represents characters and words containing acute-accented vowels, predominantly from Romance and Slavic languages.
This vector activates on anatomical and biological directional or structural prefixes and suffixes.
This vector represents Portuguese word endings or suffixes containing the letter combination "-as".
Adverbs and adverbial morphemes in Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on word fragments and suffixes containing common Latin-derived roots and inflectional endings.
This vector represents word fragments and prefixes predominantly starting with the letters 'a' and 'e' across multiple languages.
This vector represents the phonetic sound "um" and words or abbreviations containing that specific sound sequence.
This feature vector activates on Spanish plural noun and adjective suffixes ending in "-os".
